title: fix(dogfood): the expression scan registers no alias for a value parsed by a roster schema
body:
Fixes #24645
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: the diff is one test file's text scan in `@objectstack/dogfood` (`"private": true`, no `files[]`). No schema, export or published package moves, so no accept set or public surface widens or narrows. Labelled `skip-changeset` on the same basis.

The hourly full run on `main` is red in "Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)" because the expression-conformance scan registered a parse RESULT as an alias of a roster schema. This PR fixes the scan. `packages/spec` is untouched, and no ledger row is added.

## Reproduction (on `origin/main` `bfc1539fe`, before the fix)

`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/expression-conformance.test.ts` in `packages/qa/dogfood` gives `Tests 2 failed | 5 passed (7)`:

- `:426` (`checkLedger`): `UNCLASSIFIED surface — add a ledger row (ADR-0060)` for nine keys, all `ui/app.zod.ts`: `NavigationContributionSchema.history`, `NavigationContributionSchema.items`, `AppBrandingSchema.history`, `NavigationAreaSchema.history`, `NavigationAreaSchema.navigation`, `AppContextSelectorSchema.history`, `AppSchema.history`, `AppSchema.navigation`, `AppSchema.apis`.
- `:518`: `ui/app.zod.ts:AppContextSelectorSchema.history: 3 declaring positions share ONE ratchet key ... ui/app.zod.ts:1466, ui/app.zod.ts:1494, ui/app.zod.ts:1522`.

The scan code, run on its own over `packages/spec/src`, shows how the chain forms. Triage's diagnosis holds, and the four "other" keys are the chain it predicted:

| line in `ui/app.zod.ts` | registered alias | how |
|---|---|---|
| 1027 | `parsed` | `LOCAL_BINDING` matches `const parsed = EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema.safeParse(source);` |
| 1028 | `authoredVisibleEnvelope` (multi-line) | `return parsed.success ? ...` hits the alias with no `field:` above it |
| 1082 | `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource` (multi-line) | the helper's call site |
| 1145 | `NavigationItemSchema` (multi-line) | `.superRefine(navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource)` |

After that, every describe line containing the word "parsed" counts as a hit: `.history` x7 and `AppSchema.apis`. So does every `z.array(NavigationItemSchema)`: `.items` and `.navigation` x2. That makes 11 positions under 9 keys, and none of them is an expression surface.

## The rule change, and why a parse call is a value

`schema.parse(v)`, `.safeParse(v)`, `.parseAsync(v)` and `.safeParseAsync(v)` return the parsed value or a result object, never a schema. Nothing can type a slot with what they bind, so a roster name that is only the receiver of one of those calls is a use of the schema, not a reference to it.

- `scanSource` now blanks every occurrence of a roster or alias name that is directly followed by one of the four parse-method calls. It does this once per line, before the hit test. So the one rule covers all three places a hit is acted on: the `LOCAL_BINDING` registration, the multi-line (enclosing top-level declaration) registration, and field attribution.
- An occurrence that is not the receiver still counts. Examples are `z.union([X, ...]).parse(v)`, or a second mention elsewhere on the line. So the narrowing errs toward registering. A false alias is a loud UNCLASSIFIED, while a missed alias silently drops the slots typed with it.
- `scanFile` is now a thin wrapper over `scanSource(text, file)`. The spelling controls run the exact code the spec walk runs.

Measured over the whole of `packages/spec/src` (the real scan code at base vs head):

- Alias table: 7 before, 3 after. Exactly `parsed`, `authoredVisibleEnvelope`, `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource` and `NavigationItemSchema` are gone. `PredicateInputSchema`, `ActionConditionInputSchema` and `actionCondition` (multi-line) are unchanged.
- Declarations: 66 before, 55 after. Exactly the 11 `ui/app.zod.ts` positions above are removed, and 0 are added.
- `via` counts: head 42, inline 1 and manual 2 are unchanged. Alias goes from 21 to 10.
- Unattributed stays at 0.

The 9 keys and the collision are gone because the false alias is gone, not because anything was classified. The ledger diff is empty. The only parse call on a roster or alias name anywhere in `packages/spec/src/**/*.zod.ts` is the one at `ui/app.zod.ts:1027`.

## Controls and ablation

`SCAN_CONTROLS` keeps its three mechanism floors and gains four spelling controls. A new test, `alias registration tells a schema from a value parsed by one`, checks each control's alias table and requires zero unattributed hits:

1. The exact `authoredVisibleEnvelope` spelling from `ui/app.zod.ts:1026-1029` registers nothing.
2. The same helper written without the local (`return EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema.safeParse(source).data;`) registers nothing. This exercises the multi-line branch.
3. The real single-line alias, `ui/action.zod.ts`'s `const ActionConditionInputSchema = z.union([z.boolean(), EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema], {`, still registers `ActionConditionInputSchema`.
4. The real multi-line alias, `ui/component.zod.ts`'s `const actionCondition = () =>` with the union on the next line, still registers `actionCondition (multi-line)`.

After the fix, at head: `Tests 8 passed (8)`. The fix was committed first. Each ablation ran through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode on the one `const referencing = ...` line. It proved the mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed, marker `grep -c` = 1 inside the run) and proved the restore (blob == HEAD `88aa5562c726`, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- **Ablation 1, the pre-fix hit test on the raw line:** `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)`. The new control is red with `the scan registered [parsed, authoredVisibleEnvelope (multi-line)] where [] was expected`. Both original failures come back: the same 9 UNCLASSIFIED keys, and the `AppContextSelectorSchema.history` collision at 1466/1494/1522.
- **Ablation 2, the screen applied to `LOCAL_BINDING` lines only:** `Tests 1 failed | 7 passed (8)`. The spec run is green, but control 2 is red with `registered [authoredVisibleEnvelope (multi-line)]`. Control 2 is the only thing that holds the multi-line branch to the rule.
- **Ablation 3, an over-broad screen that blanks every binding line:** `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)`. Control 3 is red with `registered [] where [ActionConditionInputSchema] was expected`, and the ratchet goes red with `STALE covers ... ui/action.zod.ts:actionObject.visible`. The `alias` floor (2) stays green under this mutation, which is why the real-alias controls exist next to it.

## Why the PR that introduced this was green (note only)

The dogfood shards never run on `pull_request` or `merge_group` events. `ci.yml`'s THE TWO SPEEDS block puts `dogfood` (three shards), `dogfood-verify`, `temporal-conformance` and `console-pin` on the full battery only, through `if: ... github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'`. The aggregate `Dogfood Regression Gate` keeps `if: always()`, so with zero expected shard attestations it concludes success.

On the introducing PR's head `e058ce508e`, the check-runs read `Dogfood Regression Gate (${{ matrix.shard }}/3) | skipped` and `Dogfood Regression Gate | success`. So no PR, spec-only or not, runs this scan before merge. The hourly full run is the designed backstop, and it caught this.

The same applies to this PR. CI will not run `expression-conformance.test.ts` here or in the queue. The local run above is the only pre-merge reading, and the first CI reading is `main`'s push and hourly battery after merge. Nothing is built for this.

## Local verification, at head `2c5a411ba`

- `expression-conformance.test.ts`: `Tests 8 passed (8)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, whose `include` covers `test/**/*`): exit 0. Both ran after `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 55 derived commands, each exit code captured before any pipe. All exit 0.
  - On the first pass, two were PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` lacked 8 packages' `dist/`. `check:type-check-debt` timed out in the queue for the shared lock.
  - Both were re-run under the lock after building those packages, and both exited 0.
  - The `--ran` reconciliation reads: `55 derived, 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- The 11 declared-wide families (`check:init-service-contract`, `live-db-isolation`, `meta-type-normalized`, `optional-error-sink`, `resume-authority-declared`, `route-envelope`, `runner-env-posture`, `settings-bind-window`, `startup-registry-verdict`, `verify-stand-in`, `wildcard-fallthrough`) and `pnpm lint`: all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Boundary, not filed: a receiver split from its `.parse(` across lines (the name ends one line and `.safeParse(` starts the next) is not recognised and still registers. That is the loud direction, and no such spelling exists in `packages/spec/src` today. Zod's `decode`/`encode` method family is likewise not in the screen. No roster or alias name is a receiver of either in the spec today.
- Local verification is narrowed to the one changed file under vitest, plus the package typecheck and the derived gates. The rest of the dogfood suite boots example apps and does not read this file. It runs on `main`'s full battery.
